findings.impact: Unmapped service accounts represent an unmonitored attack surface.
findings.recommendation: Onboard all service accounts into CyberArk within 30 days.

findings.title: Critical asset classification gap — 12 of 87 assets unclassified
findings.description: 12 assets in scope have not been assigned a criticality classification.
findings.impact: Without classification, controls cannot be applied proportionately.
findings.recommendation: Complete classification for all in-scope assets.

findings.title: Outbound traffic to anomalous geographies not alerted in real time
findings.description: SIEM rules do not include geo-based detection for outbound connections.
findings.impact: Data exfiltration would not trigger SOC alerts.
findings.recommendation: Implement geo-based detection rules in SIEM.
findings.disputeReason: Existing perimeter controls block direct outbound connections.

findings.title: PAM session recordings retention below regulatory minimum (90d vs 12m)
findings.description: CyberArk retains privileged-session recordings for 90 days; RBI requires 12 months.
findings.recommendation: Extend retention to at least 12 months.

findings.description: Core Banking DB restoration tests are annual vs quarterly policy.
findings.impact: Extended detection gap for backup corruption.

findings.title: Patch compliance below 95% threshold for endpoints (current 82%)
findings.description: Endpoint patch compliance at 82% vs 95% policy threshold.
findings.impact: Increased attack surface from unpatched endpoints.

findings.title: Security awareness coverage on contractors below 80%
findings.impact: Elevated insider risk from untrained contractors.

findings.title: Encryption-at-rest cipher inconsistent across data stores
findings.description: Mix of AES-128 and AES-256 for PII stores.
findings.impact: May not meet RBI DPSC minimum for PII.
findings.recommendation: Migrate all PII stores to AES-256.
findings.disputeReason: AES-128 meets RBI DPSC minimum norm.
